news.title: 19th Cheer for the Cure a Huge Success at Bloomfield High, with Tremendous Enthusiasm and Accolades Honoring the Late Karen Centinaro
news.excerpt: The 19th annual Cheer for the Cure cheerleading competition filled Foley Field in Bloomfield on the evening of Oct. 6, honoring the late Karen Centinaro.
